description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing reminders in a customer billing system, including listing, creating (sending), and retrieving reminder details. It interacts with database models and external integrations for email and WhatsApp notifications.

classes.name: models.ReminderOut
classes.description: Response model for reminder data output.

classes.name: models.ReminderCreate
classes.description: Input model for creating a reminder.

classes.name: models.Reminder
classes.description: Database model representing a reminder record.

classes.name: models.ReminderStatusEnum
classes.description: Enumeration for reminder status (e.g., sent, failed).

methods.name: list_reminders( invoice_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by invoice ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list reminders, optionally filtered by invoice ID.

methods.name: send_reminder( reminder: models.ReminderCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to trigger sending a reminder via email or WhatsApp, and records the attempt.

methods.name: get_reminder( reminder_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific reminder by ID.

ctags.name: list_reminders
ctags.signature: ( invoice_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by invoice ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
